checks.expected: EACH PUMP SHALL OPERATE FOR A MINIMUM OF 10 CONSECUTIVE MINUTES

mupdf.text: IN THE EVENT THAT THE LEAD SECONDARY HEATING WATER PUMP IS OPERATING ABOVE 90% CAPACITY AND IS UNABLE TO MAINTAIN THE DIFFERENTIAL PRESSURE SETPOINT, THE DDC CONTROLLER SHALL SEQUENCE THE FOLLOWING: 1. SEND AN ENABLE COMMAND TO THE LAG SECONDARY HEATING WATER PUMP. a. VALIDATE THE RUNNING STATUS THROUGH THE VFD CONTROL INTERFACE. b. IF THE SECONDARY PUMP FAILS TO START, AN ALARM OF THE EVENT SHALL BE SENT TO THE OPERATOR'S WORKSTATION. 2. THE TWO SECONDARY HEATING WATER PUMPS SHALL CONTINUE TO OPERATE IN PARALLEL UTILIZING THE SAME CONTROL POINT. 3. WHEN THE CAPACITY OF THE LAG PUMP IS REDUCED TO 35%, THE DDC CONTROLLER SHALL STAGE BACK DOWN TO THE LEAD SECONDARY HEATING WATER PUMP IN REVERSE ORDER FROM THE STEPS NOTED ABOVE. 4. EACH PUMP SHALL OPERATE FOR A MINIMUM OF 10 CONSECUTIVE MINUTES AND WHEN DISABLED, SHALL REMAIN OFF FOR A MINIMUM OF 5 CONSECUTIVE MINUTES BEFORE RESTARTING TO PREVENT SHORT-CYCLING EXCEPT WHEN MANUALLY ENABLED/DISABLED OR BY THE OCCUPIED/UNOCCUPIED SYSTEM SCHEDULE.

checks.expected: THE HEATING WATER SUPPLY TEMPERATURE SET POINT SHALL BE RESET BY THE DDC CONTROLLER BASED ON THE POSITION OF THE HEATING WATER COIL CONTROL VALVES.

mupdf.text: HEATING WATER SUPPLY TEMPERATURE SET POINT RESET SCHEDULE: THE HEATING WATER SUPPLY TEMPERATURE SET POINT SHALL BE RESET BY THE DDC CONTROLLER BASED ON THE POSITION OF THE HEATING WATER COIL CONTROL VALVES. WHEN THE SYSTEM IS FIRST ENABLED, A MAXIMUM HEATING WATER SUPPLY TEMPERATURE OF 140°F (ADJUSTABLE) +/- 1°F (ADJUSTABLE) SHALL BE PROVIDED AND SHALL DECREASE LINEARLY (BASED ON 1°F INTERVALS - ADJUSTABLE) DOWN TO 100°F (ADJUSTABLE) AS LONG AS ALL HEATING COIL CONTROL VALVES ARE AT A POSITION OF 90% OPEN (ADJUSTABLE) OR LESS. AS THREE OR MORE HEATING COIL CONTROL VALVES MODULATE TO A POSITION GREATER THAN 90% OPEN (ADJUSTABLE), THE REVERSE CYCLE SHALL OCCUR. THE HEATING WATER SET POINT SHALL AUTOMATICALLY RESET TO THE MAXIMUM HEATING WATER SUPPLY TEMPERATURE WHENEVER ONE OR MORE HEATING COIL CONTROL VALVES MODULATE TO 100% OPEN FOR A MINIMUM PERIOD OF 60 CONSECUTIVE SECONDS (ADJUSTABLE).
